title: FDA 21 CFR Part 11
source: 21 CFR Part 11, Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures (Subparts B and C)

controls.§11.10(e): Secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails that never obscure earlier entries
controls.§11.10(f): Operational system checks that enforce the permitted sequence of steps and events
controls.§11.10(g): Authority checks: only authorized individuals use the system, sign or alter records
controls.§11.50: Signature manifestations: the signer, the date and time, and the meaning of the signature
controls.§11.70: Signature and record linking: signatures cannot be excised, copied or transferred to falsify a record

limits.§11.50: Approvals record the principal's name in the charter, the decision and the time. A printed full name and a stated meaning of each signature are the deployment's to add.
